findings.issue: The Na+/K+ pump stoichiometry is incorrect. The pump exports 3 Na+ ions, hence 3 positive charges, for every 2 K+ ions imported per ATP hydrolyzed, not 10 positive charges. This also changes the net charge movement from one positive charge exported per cycle to eight.
findings.evidence: CURRENT: "the pump exports 3 positive charges for every 2 it imports." PROPOSED: "It exports 10 positive charges for every 2 it imports."
